description: An application submitted under Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for a non material amendment to planning permission DC/25/140640, dated 04 November 2025, to amend the approved development description.ÿOriginal Description:'Demolition of warehouse building to the rear and the construction of a part 2/part 4 storey building, conversion of office building and construction of an additional storey at roof at the front, together with the change of use from mixed use classes B8, E(g) and C3 to the sole residential use C3, to provide 8 homes, amenity space, shared courtyard garden, landscaping, new access stair, bins store and cycle storage, and all associated works' at 41-43, and Land to the rear of 45-47 Beadnell Road SE23 ÿProposed Amended Description:'Demolition of warehouse building to the rear and the construction of a part 2/part 4 storey building, conversion of office building and construction of an additional storey at roof at the front, together with the change of use from mixed use classes B8, E(g) and C3 to the sole residential use C3, to provide self-contained dwellings, amenity space, shared courtyard garden, landscaping, new access stair, bins store and cycle storage, and all associated works' at 41-43, and Land to the rear of 45-47 Beadnell Road SE23 ÿReason for Amendment:To remove the explicit reference to the number of residential units and to allow the addition of a new condition securing the quantum of development for the site at 41-43 and Land to the rear of 45-47 Beadnell Road SE23
